reviews.text: Amazing pumpkin flower arranging workshop!
Fun experience and nice staff cute doggos
Nice place in the beautiful Central location in London. Very friendly dogs of different breeds.

We absolutely loved our experience here!

Everything was really well organised from start to finish. The staff member who looked after our group was lovely — she explained everything clearly, told us about the dogs and gave us treats to feed them, which made the experience even more fun and interactive.

What we especially liked was that the groups are kept quite small, so everyone actually gets plenty of time to interact with the dogs. You don’t feel like you’re competing for their attention, and everyone gets a chance to feed, pet and spend time with them.

The dogs were absolutely adorable, friendly and clearly very well looked after. We were given treats for them twice during the experience, which was such a nice touch.

Overall, everything felt very well thought out and organised. We had such a great time and genuinely felt that the experience was 100% worth the money. Would definitely recommend!
Super daycare spot for the furry friends to hang out 🐾 🐾

A wonderful pet store on the Fulham Road - really lovely welcome from the team and they really care about visiting dogs. They stock some really cool and unique products to buy and you can get a quick coffee while you’re there!
Family spent great time , wonderful experience

i had come as a surprise by my partner to celebrate my birthday, and it was such an unforgettable experience; i had gone for their 45 minute Pet-a-Pooch experience and got to meet the absolute sweetest pups, play with them, pet them, and feed them treats!

the session was run by maggie who’s an absolute gem, she ensured that both humans and dogs were comfortable throughout the session, reminded us of their names, spoke to clients and learned more about their experiences with dogs, and ensured we always had treats on hand to feed the dogs.

maggie also took a few photos of me which made me so ecstatic! it was such a kind gesture and really captured the moment perfectly for me.

i highly recommend coming here for the Pet-a-Pooch experience, or even for their cafe (located right as you enter)!
Such a joyful and happy experience. Staff were amazing. And the cookies are to die for!
Very fun Jino is a good trickster

Perfect,immaculate experience for the full hour, cutest dogs even when in doubt these little guys would raise you from the depths of despair, my grandfather just perished in a self started house fire and this rlly made me smile again🛀🛀💔❤️😚 …
Had a very Nice session with All the little dogs. They were fun and very Nice. They loved the treats provided from the staff.
Super cute cafe with lovely helpful staff. The pet a pooch was super fun and worth every penny, will 100 percent come again, all the dogs were adorable, very well behaved and so soft!
Brilliant experience!! The dogs are so adorable, and staff are all nice!!
had the sweetest birthday here! Poppy was so lovely and the service was incredible.
Amazing experience and Poppy was so lovely and hospitable!

Nova has had a wonderful introduction, benefiting from two short stays building towards a longer one. She is so happy to see everyone and the care she has experienced shines through. She and I can’t thank you enough.
Pippa Brierley
Beautiful!! So friendly.

I was reading the reviews before I went but after I went I can say it was well worth it.
You can tell the place really cares for the dogs and your experience.

The highlight for me is that they limit the session to 6 people max in the pen so you all get proper time with all the dogs which I absolutely loved. Especially this day and age where businesses are all about cramming people to get more money but don't value the experience. Not the case here!

I was worried because I went to a cat cafe before and the cats were lazy and there were so many people and they didn't come to me so I just didn't enjoy. But each and everyone of these dogs were so adorable and so lively. If I could, I would take them allll homeeee.
They also gave us treats (three times) to feed them. I was just expecting them to give me just once so that was amazing.

Overall, the place, vibes, dog and people were the best pet cafe I've ever visited and I hope more follow this standard. Loved it so much, would defo go again and would very much recommend to everyone.

Lovely little secret dog cafe...good coffee.... as I have no pets and just simply needed the black brew which I must say has a strong fruity kick so on the acidic side and a slightly dark taste too...calming here but no dogs as of yet!..😃😃....but now off to work as for
Sarra the barista what a lovely warm welcome and lovely conversation.. 🥂 cheers...xx

Reservations are required for the dog-themed cafe.

You can't pick up the dogs (most are dachshunds).

The dogs are all super cute. One is particularly barking. The dogs are quite adept at their tasks and know there are two rounds of treats.

After their shift, they hide in a corner to relax.

Time flies by. It's a fun and relaxing place.
I think the pictures here says it all. Such a fantastic experience that was well needed for us. The cafe had great homemade food and beverage facilities too. Would love to go back!
Great fun, incredibly well behaved dogs and it’s a great set up.

Had the best time playing with all the dogs! The cafe had such a lovely, bright, clean and cosy vibe,  you can tell a lot of care goes into making it feel so welcoming. A perfect afternoon hanging out with the dogs, and the staff were so friendly, warm and passionate. Would definitely recommend!

I can’t recommend King’s Dog Daycare enough. My dog Sonya goes absolutely wild with excitement the moment we leave South Kensington station. She adores the King’s team and is so loved and well cared for. I honestly wouldn’t dream of leaving her anywhere else in London.

They open early and close later, which is incredibly convenient for anyone working full-time. I also love being able to see what Sonya is up to during the day through their (often hilarious) Instagram stories. Being able to purchase coffee and pastries at the drop-off is an added bonus during my commute. It’s great that she can be groomed during daycare hours, too.

Huge thanks to the whole King’s team. We’d be lost without you and can’t wait for the overnight boarding option to start.

Hard to accurately describe how much my spaniel puppy loves Kings. It is absolutely her favourite place. I am fortunate to have the flexibility in my life to be with her during the day, so don't require daycare. But, after sending her once while I had an appointment, and seeing what a ball she had, I built a few afternoons a week into her life, and she is a far more contented pup for it. Knowing it's focused on smaller dogs helps me feel it will always be a manageable environment for her. Charlie, Nick, & Kate, who cares for her so so well, along with the rest of the team, have created such a down-to-earth, welcoming, warm and safe place. There is always enough going on that I know Coco will have a pal to romp with, while never feeling there are too many pups, and anything less than eyes on her and care for her at all times. I've recommended Kings to others in the neighbourhood more times than I can count (though most know it from experience or reputation already). Anyone who has taken their pup, after our encouragement, has been just as pleased as we are. Oh, and the grooming services are fab too, with Reni having done a lovely job of introducing Coco (and I) to the grooming process. Pet a Pooch, which I visited before I had her, is also not to miss, and such a lovely offering for dog lovers in the neighbourhood who might not have their own...
We loved the Pet A Pooch experience and will happily come back in the future when we’re in London! This was definitely a highlight of our trip!

We had such a lovely experience at this dog café! We were in a small group of six people, which made the atmosphere really relaxed and comfortable. The dogs were incredibly friendly, affectionate, and clearly loved interacting with visitors. They happily came to play with us and cuddle, which made the whole visit even more special.

The staff were also wonderful – very kind, welcoming, and friendly. You can really feel that they care about both the dogs and the guests. ❤️

The entire team at Kings is absolutely wonderful, and the daycare experience has had such a positive impact on our dog Cashew!

He used to be a bit nervous about playing with other dogs and leaving mum and dad, and now he literally races through the door every morning to see his human and dog friends at Kings. It’s been so nice to watch his confidence grow.

We’re so grateful to have found them and would highly recommend Kings to anyone looking for daycare for their small dog.
Very relaxing setting, super cute dogs and really nice staff. Definitely worth the experience ❤️

My dog Rambo absolutely loves daycare at Kings! This has been a game changer as someone who gets anxious to leave him alone! The staff are better than I could’ve imagined, I’d highly recommend anyone to send their pup here!
The team at Kings are simply the best - professional, fun and 100% reliable. Our dog literally runs in the door every morning, she couldn’t be happier to be there! Highly recommended.

Charlie, Nick, Kate and the team at King’s are absolutely wonderful.  Our little dog loves his sessions there, we all love the Instagram stories we get to watch of him and his friends, and we wouldn’t send him anywhere else.  Everyone is so welcoming, friendly, adaptable, caring and professional.  We are so happy to be part of their world !

We absolutely love Kings! The team is incredible and their passion for our furry friends is evident in how much our doggy loves it there. He will run there every day and has the best time playing. The groom is one of the best in our opinion too! The staff and owners are all incredibly kind and is such a happy , vibrant and cosy place. Our young dog has so much energy, can’t tell you what a massive help it is to be able to bring our King Charles there to have a big play with friends! Thanks Nick, Charlie and team!!
Made the best date ever
This place is the greatest thing to happen to London since the pub. King Louey is the best but all the dogs - and the staff - are wonderful. Highly recommended.
It was really fun and the dogs are so cute!! But I didn’t see chow chow 🥲 …

Went here to hang out with the dogs, worth every penny! They're clearly well looked after and loved by the staff here, and it's great for helping to socialise the dogs too. Staff are knowledgeable and really lovely, and very clearly enjoy what they do. We stayed for food too, the selection is small but varied. I had a delicious focaccia and a particularly good coffee. Will come back when possible, if nothing else than to see Big Louie (and if he's there, Little Louie too!)
Had a great time at pet a pooch!! Such sweet dogs, and lovely staff. Had a toasted sandwich too which was delicious!
This store takes out other people's foster dogs to play with strangers and charges a fee.
Such a fun and welcoming place for both dogs and owners. The space feels relaxed and well cared for, and the staff clearly love what they do. It’s easy to spend more time here than planned.
Amazing place

The team kindly hosted our Christmas party in the evening provided delicious food and drinks for us all! They were very hospitable and even brought their doggies along which was very much appreciated by the team! I always pop in here for a coffee for a cheer up with the dogs and they have delicious food, if you are ever stuck for lunch in the area pop in!

I thoroughly enjoyed my visit. The dogs were absolutely adorable. The staff gave us dog treats to feed the puppies. Finally, a sweet dachshund curled up in my lap and let me pet him. If I ever return to London, I'll definitely visit this café again!

Very poor experience with them myself.  Ordered a jacket for my dog arrived to small. I have asked for a return and refund numerous times and i just keep getting fobbed off offering me replacements but asking me to pay extra for a new delivery etc. I just wanted to return my item simple as and unfortunately i have been unsuccessful in doing so as they do not have any direct return info or links on website, only way possible is to email them and ask for a approval of refund lol. Very unprofessional
One of the best experiences in London! The staff and dogs were incredible!! Cannot recommend enough!!

We had an absolutely wonderful time!! The dogs were gorgeous and so well behaved. You can tell they love the 'pet a pooch' sessions as much as the people. We can see why this is so popular and gets booked up weeks in advance. We will definitely be back!
It's the perfect way to start into the day, you simply can't stop smiling and enjoying the time with the dogs. It's pure joy
Everything about them is amazing!

Such a nice place to unwind, the staff was very nice and friendly, if you are a dog lover but don’t own one this is the perfect mood booster where you can play with the dogs and recharge. Warning: may cause instant happiness 🥰 …
Such a lovely experience, all of the dogs were super loving and an absolute pleasure to be with. Can't think of a better way to spend my Birthday. x
Amazing experience!
Absolutely incredible experience! Such friendly staff and dogs! Would recommend to any dog lover. We will definitely be returning

At first glance, you might think the prices are a bit high, but once you experience it for yourself, you'll realize it's all worth it. Spending time with these dogs like this could keep me from seeing a psychologist for six months… The staff are friendly and gentle, and the dogs are incredibly enthusiastic, friendly, and cheerful—even though these little guys are only after the treats in your hand! 🤣 In short, I would recommend this place to all my Chinese friends. It's a fantastic experience, especially with this Chihuahua boss. I was truly honored to be his ride today—even though it was only for thirty minutes! Hahahaha

When I first booked it, I thought it was a little bit overpriced, but when I left this place, I felt like every minute was worth every penny. The dogs are so taken care of, you can really see that the owners and the staff prioritise them. Everyone was extremely nice. We had an amazing time. There is a lot of souvenirs that you can buy for either yourself or your pets. The place was super clean. I would 100% recommend this experience and I’m definitely gonna go back when I’m back in London. Much much love🤍
Such a wonderful place - the best part of our trip was going here, lovely staff and the best most beautiful dogs<3
So much fun! Nick was great and so accommodating! Such a lovely relaxing thing to do! X
Such a lovely homely environment, lovely staff and great cookies! Honestly the perfect recipe for happiness❤️ Lyra has a soft place in my heart x
Great experience, lovely dogs
Amazing drinks and great time with the dogs 🥰 …

We had a wonderful very memorable “pet a pooch” experience for my daughter’s 11th birthday celebration. We booked a private session for 5 girls and they had a wonderful time playing with King Louie, Lyra and all their pals. Charlie and Nick were delightful. The food and drink were fabulous too. An amazing set up. Has obviously not helped our can’t-get-a-family-dog-yet! Highly recommend!
Cute spot
Such a brilliant experience. All the pups were so friendly and playful
The best 45 minutes of my life
Thank you!!

Wonderful place!! The staff is very competent, kind and knowledgeble. The owners and staff are very very caring with the dogs. You can really see they genuinely love the dogs, is not just a business. Also, I did the 50 minutes dog petting..wonderful experience..I highly reccomend to go there and bring your dog for daycare or grooming. Last thing, they make amazing coffes and pastries!!! Thank you again guys!!

Amazing Experience at King's Dog Daycare!
My kids and I had a wonderful time visiting King's Dog Daycare today. The owner was incredibly welcoming and let us play with the dogs, which was a real treat for the children. The dogs were happy, well-behaved, and clearly loved being there.
While the kids were having a blast, I also got to enjoy a delicious cookie and a great cup of coffee. This place is not just a dog daycare; it's a warm, friendly spot for animal lovers to relax.
I highly recommend King's Dog Daycare to anyone who loves animals. It's a fantastic place with a wonderful atmosphere and a truly kind owner. We can't wait to come back!

Regards for LAYRA, LUI, GEORGE 🙂🙂🙂🙂
Such a cute and fun experience we've got 🤍 The pups were adorable and the staff gave us some treats to play with them. The local is clean and felt very cozy! …
Definitely worth visiting, all the dogs are lovely, staff aswell

Loved spending time with these beautiful sweet dogs!  I will be back.
Thank you
The sweetest dogs!

My partner and I came for a pet-a-pooch and honestly had the best day! The staff were all so lovely and the dogs were the cutest and friendliest! They checked if anyone was nervous before they came out warning they may bark a bit but everyone was okay and had so much fun with the pups! Cannot recommend enough🥰🥰 …
best experience to spend time w dogs and staff are very nice!
Feeling good and enjoying time with the dogs

First visit today to pet a pooch. 45 minutes of pure joy. Birthday treat for my 14 yr old daughter. She said it was her best gift ever. George & Louie took an immediate liking to her. As we are local this will be a monthly treat. Well worth the £20

What an awesome place! Absolutely love the concept and the cafe is perfect - tasty drinks and treats with very friendly staff. Love seeing the dogs come in and out, and lots of my favorite kind - dachshunds :) Please bring this to California, but in the meantime, we'll be back with our dachshund next time!
best minutes of my whole life

The most welcoming atmosphere and staff 😊 the pet-a-pooch sessions are wonderful and the dogs are really friendly, showing how much they get out of socialising with the people who visit 😊 the cafe is also really nice, with great food and drink options and treats/toys for you to buy for your own dog 😊 …
I take the boys here multiple times a week for some puppy love and cuddles whilst drinking the best hot chocolate ever!!!!!
Great experience, friendly staff the dogs were all delightful

Just the most amazing place.  I leave my dog there regularly and he absolutely adores it.  If he could walk there in his sleep he would!  He's desperate to go every day and I struggle to make him leave.  Nick and Charlie and the whole team are amazing.  Couldn't recommend it enough.  And also Reni does the best grooming too and gets it just right.
Best day ever :)
Everyone is extremely friendly and they take the best care of all the pets.

This is one of the most incredible experiences i had ever! So so enjoyable and the sweetest dogs you could meet. They do an act show of appearance. You pay 20 pounds and get to cuddle and love them for an hour. And they provide doggy treats and the place is very clean and the staff is just amazing. I love everything about this place. They also do private session like you could take the whole hour just for you.
Not just for dogs. Excellent cafe with delicious cookies and cakes.

Went there for a quick lunch.
They have a variety of savoury and sweet options including home made banana bread. I had a flat white coffee, turkey truffle as well as mozzarella basil sandwiches.
The sandwiches were delicious and the coffee was spot on! The space is very calm with lots of natural material and inviting you to just take a moment for yourself! And the corner means you can let the local traffic wiz past as you watch peacefully from your seat!
Then you can enjoy the dogginess and everything about it! Yes!
Cafe tea & toasted sandwich. Dog care area with plenty of seating.
Really good!!! Many cute dogs, especially Lyra!!

Words cannot describe how fun and exciting it is here. The dogs are the absolute CUTEST and the whole experience was very well executed and so so memorable and fun. Their cafe is so cozy with yummy bites and drinks. The staff is veryy friendly and welcoming I cannot wait to return. It’s a MUST visit you cannot miss it!!!!!!
This place does amazing coffees , not to be missed !!

We had an amazing experience here!

I surprised my girlfriend with a visit here after she recently lost her dog and was in much need of some canine cuddles. The dogs were all incredibly cute and playful. The size of the session was well thought through with more dogs than people so it was easy to have a dog or two cuddled up with you. I’m not someone who’s grown up with dogs or is always particularly comfortable with them but these dogs are so well behaved and cute I was not nervous at all.

The owner ran the session amazingly. Very energetic guy who clearly has a deep passion for dogs and has built great relationships with them. All the staff were lovely - the woman working in the cafe set the tone greeting us with a big smile and high energy!

Overall a great experience that I couldn’t recommend more!

My friend and I were walking around the neighborhood and found this place by accident! What a HAPPY ACCIDENT!!! best place ever! I've never seen a dog Cafe before! Everything is so clean and smells amazing!! I had a latte and it was very yummy. Met the owners and they're so nice!! 100% recommend this place!
LOVE IT!! Amazing service, coffee, and the dogs are super cute!

I had a disappointing daycare experience. They were kind and generous before applying for the packages, but after that, they were very negligent. I was anxious when I left my dog ​​there, and I was anxious because I was not sure how she would be doing there. In fact, my dog ​​became timid after going there. (She is usually very friendly.) If you love your dog, please think carefully and consider registering.
Literally the cutest sweetest place ever. Super nice and talkative staff, the dogs were sooo adorable, really loved the two sausage dogs :3 and amazing banana bread
I love this place! The dogs are so well behaved and the owners are so lovely. Me and my friends come here regularly
This is my favorite place to hang out and work! My order recommendation: Chai Latte & Nutty Ham sandwich. They have a really cool petting experience which is a super mood booster!! Recommend 100%%

I called in earlier today just for a Takeaway coffee and cake. Two members of staff were talking and carried on talking to the next 30 seconds or so they didn’t acknowledge I was there, so I left and got a coffee up the road.

I just visited King's Dog Daycare in Chelsea while parked near the Royal Brompton Hospital and was pleasantly surprised! Though primarily a doggy daycare, they offer takeaway coffee and a chance to book "pet a pooch" or just relax with tea or coffee and a pastry. The gentleman who served me was incredibly friendly and welcoming. The dogs were adorable, and the two coffees I got were delicious and reasonably priced. It’s a unique and charming spot—I’ll definitely be back!

SJ , Charlie and Nick were so kind and helpful, it was a wonderful experience, the dogs were lovely and we were given treats for the dogs , I will definitely come back and it’s a experience I would 100% recommend for coming with friends or even alone ! The coffee was great as well and the vibe and atmosphere were amazing ! 10/10 !!!

Such a fun place. The Pet-a-Pooch is a great experience, it's my second time being there and will definitely be back. The dogs are so friendly and the atmosphere is relaxing. A really unique experience. There's a variety of dogs, they are all so well behaved and it was interesting getting to know all their personalities. Being able to give them treats is also a great part of the experience. The staff are absolutely lovely and friendly. The cafe part itself is also very cute, they serve a great matcha latte. Definitely a must-do experience for any dog lover.
Really nice cafe, delicious latte and cookie too
Adorable little cafe / dog daycare. They do a great job with grooming my little dog, and the owner is super friendly.
My friend brought me here for my birthday and we had such a lovely time! The staff were great and the dogs were so sweet - it was a really nice experience. I’m excited to come back 🐶 …

Had the best time with all the dogs today! The set up is brilliant and the staff are so friendly! You get special treats to give to the dogs (the dogs are so clever with their tricks!). Will definitely be back. Just brilliant!

A lovely place ! Thoroughly enjoyed all the cute dogs.
Thank you everyone !
Lovely dogs and excellent service! A truly delightful experience
Very cute and wholesome experience, the dogs are precious and you get to even treat them. Loved it.

I have opted for King's Dog Daycare for my wife's birthday and it has been the best experience ever. I cannot put in words how rewarding and fulfilling the whole experience is, how we have been treated, welcomed and looked after by the amazing, human and kind owners and the interaction with all the playful and gentle dogs, including King Louie. This has become our favourite London place! If you are in London and want to avoid the crowded streets, museums or shops, make sure you pay a visit and book the Photoshoot or Pet-a-Pooch (or both) as it is pure therapy for your soul!

Nice coffee and teas and the dogs and extremely cute and fun.
recommend this place for any dog lovers
Cute dogs, friendly staff, great atmosphere, no complaints!! 100% will be back!

Wasted my time!!! Booked online for my 2 dogs for the whole day of day care 7am-7pm, got a reminder so I assumed it was confirmed. Drove there for more than hour that means I left the house 5:30am for a 7am day care session but was just told my dogs were not on the list for today and it's not the way they work and couldnt accept them. Nobody has made an effort to explain whatever their policy prior to my booking and why would you remind me if you didnt accept me anyway. An email explaining your rubbish website cant bring the time you wasted. Even now, I can still book same thing on your website. What a dissapppointment. And if your booking starts at 7am why nobody responsible for dogs are present?? Only a lady who says shes not encharge coz she only works in coffee shop and when I ask her to call the one responsible for it, she just said no point.

We had the most amazing time here. All of the dogs are super friendly and well trained. Lola and Luna were my favourites❤️ Charlie was really helpful and made sure all the rules were followed and the dogs were treated well! We will definitely come back😁 …

Took 7 x 11 year old girls there for my daughter’s birthday. 1 hour of joyful cuddling with a bunch of gorgeous good natured dogs of multiple breeds in a lovely setting. Our hostess Charlie did a great job of overseeing everything. Kids all had a great time and came away chatting about which their favourite was. Highly recommend 👍👍👍 …
Absolutely incredible experience. I can’t wait to come back and pet the dogs even more. Everyone is so friendly and you can see how well the dogs are cared for and loved. Thank you!

I’m in London for holiday and was really missing my pup😭 I went in to this place without an appointment and they were kind enough to get me on the schedule last minute. I almost died when I saw the doggies. They were so friggon adorable and sweet. Best day ever💗 …
